Practical reading

Follow instructions and put steps in order

Use sequence markers, pronouns and cause-and-effect language to rebuild the correct process.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Find the starting condition

Instructions may begin with preparation: collect a document, switch off equipment or check an appointment time. Do not skip this first condition.

Track sequence words

First, next, then, after, before, finally and until create a time line. Mark them when ordering mixed steps.

01PURPOSE02CLUE03EVIDENCE04ANSWER

Resolve pronouns

Words such as it, they and this refer back to a person, object or action. Identify that reference before moving the sentence.

Test the completed process

Read the reordered steps from beginning to end. Each step should create the condition needed for the next one.
